body_text:
Complex conjugation satisfies $\overline{z+w}=\bar z+\bar w$,
$\overline{zw}=\bar z\bar w$, and $z\bar z=|z|^2$. Consequently
$z^{-1}=\bar z/|z|^2$ for $z\ne0$. Geometrically, conjugation is
reflection across the real axis.
